stocks.headline: Up 31.5% to 165.05 on 2.7x normal volume after the board voted Huang back as CEO. Morning call: right, because the 143.73 trigger fired at the open.
stocks.why: The slide was about leadership and China, not the business. Last quarter EPS was 2.68 vs 2.47 expected, sales grew 106%, next year's forecasts are up 28% in 90 days, and the stock trades at 8x forward profit. Huang's return removes the biggest unknown, and it lifted TSM, MU, ARM, SMCI and CRWV with it. The new risk is political: members of Congress from both parties are attacking the decision on national-security grounds, and the China chip-shipment problem has not gone away.

long_term.reason: The house view is Wait. We move up one step because the reason to wait, no CEO, is gone, and a business growing this fast at its lowest valuation in 5 years is cheap.

stocks.what_would_change_it: Washington moving to restrict Nvidia's leadership or its China sales would send this back to Wait.
